result:
The rise from underground and the rarity light shafts shipped as v30.34 (commit d99bcb15). Preflight and the gate both passed, and the seed 4242 fingerprint held (ents 85/374, containers 165/593). I did not take any screenshots or run the critic, because no UI screen stages these. The check proves the clip, the rise timing, the skip, the sink and the shaft by calling the draw code. Nobody has looked at it on screen.

- **Rise (pick 77):** at raid start the raider comes up out of a dark hatch in the ground. The rise takes 1.3 s with a teal beam and a dust ring.
- **Skip and no blocking:** any key, click, touch, step, shot or roll ends the rise at once. It is only how the figure is drawn, so movement and fights are never blocked.
- **Exit:** the same sink plays over the existing 1.4 s boarding hold, so extraction adds no delay. Letting go of the hold lifts him back up.
- **Light shafts (pick 75):** a pile someone dropped, yours or a teammate's, stands in a light column of its best rarity's colour. Height is 58 px for uncommon, 88 rare, 118 elite and 148 gold, and common gets none.
- **Unopened boxes and caches:** these never get a shaft. I kept that on purpose, since his 08-26 note says a box must not show what it holds and lean6 removed the item glow.

The raid-start rise also applies to the arcade-mode raid start, since that goes through the same code.

Not done: no sound on the rise, and the log line in `notes\ui\changes.md` has no picture. The notes are in `notes\c-02-ascent-and-light-shafts.md`.
